_description: Blocks git commands that destroy shared history or silently discard work. Based on Matt Pocock's git-guardrails pattern. Deny rules for specific force variants must stay before the broader bare-push warn rule. Note: 'git push --force' is a substring of '--force-with-lease', so --force-with-lease is also denied by this preset — intended, since AI agents should not force-push in any form.

extra_banned_commands.reason: Force push rewrites shared history and is blocked in all forms, including --force-with-lease. Commit to a branch and open a PR instead.
